boot.failedDescription: Kutup could not be reached, or signing in through your account did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

home.title: Your maps

home.saveFolderGone: The folder you chose for new maps is gone, so new maps go to My files.

status.editsWait: View only until the owner updates access

list.quota: Your storage is full, so changes are no longer saved as versions.
